title: Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit: One Open Benefit per Member
content:
**Standard.** A member holds at most 1 Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit that is not terminated, and that benefit is tied to the member's open Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment. A new retail benefit may be opened only when no retail benefit of that member is pending effective, active or locked in.

## Basis of the check

- The check rests on the system record of the member's retail benefits and their statuses, not on what the member says.
- The object checked is the member: every retail benefit carrying that member counts, whichever enrollment it was opened under.
- A retail benefit that is terminated does not stand in the way of a new one.

## Status table

| Status of the member's existing retail benefit | A new retail benefit may be opened |
|---|---|
| Pending effective | No |
| Active | No |
| Locked in | No |
| Terminated (and no other benefit pending effective, active or locked in) | Yes |
| No retail benefit on record | Yes |

## Example (hypothetical)

A member whose only Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit is terminated, and who holds no other retail benefit, may have a new one opened with a new plan enrollment. A member whose benefit is pending effective because the plan enrollment starts next month already holds the 1 open benefit allowed, so no second one is opened.
